newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croat Trgovacka Banka sees 96 pre-tax at HRK36 mln.
newsitem.headline: Croat Trgovacka Banka sees 96 pre-tax at HRK36 mln.

text.p: Croatian private bank Trgovacka Banka said on Monday its preliminary pre-tax profit rose to 36.4 million kuna in the year to December 31, 1996 from 30.3 million a year earlier.
It said in a statement faxed to Reuters total income rose to 78.624 million kuna from 54.4 million. Roughly 55 percent was interest income.
But the bank's costs were also higher at 42.210 million, compared to 30.3 million kuna in 1995.
Trgovacka posted a net profit of 23.0 million kuna in 1995.
The bank would like to increase its relatively small share of Croatia's overcrowded banking sector to around five percent.
It was one of smaller banks in Croatia to get a credit line of 10 million marks last year from the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) aimed at supporting the private sector.

Trgovacka now plans to boost its 70 million kuna capital with new, as yet unspecified share issue, which will be proposed to the annual meeting in February, board member Tomislav Vuic told Reuters. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
